log.notes_to_self: Long-run goal: identify one reachable reporting kind, then omit it and kill the other 9 criminals/day. Three reachable primary kinds becoming established would usually reduce the afternoon-compatible population below 1,000; two leave substantial headroom. Today's deliberately isolated experiment killed ONLY national + both gazette criminals. Thus tomorrow's nonnational traced count identifies gazette: if >=1, sector records are reachable. Immediately stop killing gazette criminals and switch to national + both victims from each other source (9/day). Do not keep probing an already identified reachable source: 3 successful traces activate its primary constraint. If tomorrow's count is 0, both gazette deaths yielded no usable traces; next isolate another previously untested source, preferably regional:East or clips: its two criminals + national only. A positive trace-count increase then identifies that source as reachable; omit it thereafter. Prefer fresh sources after negative tests, since negatives raise their probability of being reachable. During isolated tests, do not kill other nonnational sources, so trace increments remain attributable. IMPORTANT caveat: hidden secondary reports can eventually activate clauses involving the omitted source's earlier probe victims, so this is not an absolute safety guarantee; monitor pool changes. Once harvesting, use quick AFTERNOON deaths, retaining night workers, students and home people (55%); >2 morning deaths would unnecessarily exclude students. Up to 10 quick entries/day; 9/day needs no timed entries. Today's two afternoon quick deaths plus one evening timed death preserve ALL routines. Target sustained 9/day: rolling five-day total 45 gives x4. Finishing uncaught has no bonus, but halving a large accumulated score is costly.

Test another fresh source, preferably clips: its 2 criminals + national only, again 2 quick afternoon and national timed evening.
